source.place: Naturality coordinate calculation after fixed-coordinate expansion.

title: Coordinate naturality of finite partial tensor comparison
statement: The coordinate form of the finite partial tensor naturality square after postcomposition with target coordinates.

proof.text: Expand each comparison by pullbackTensor_fixed_coordinates and use naturality of the fixed tensor, fixed pullback realization, and upper-star tensor comparison.

lean.statement: theorem finitePartialTensor_identityNaturality_coordinates (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn) (X : SixFunctorSpace D) : let U := S.finite.pull (𝟙 X) let V := CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S (𝟙 X) let T := Functor.uncurry.obj (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S X) ∀ (M M' : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X) (L L' : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn X.obj.left) (f : M ⟶ M') (g : L ⟶ L'), (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map (U.map (T.map (Prod.mkHom f g))) ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.pullbackTensorComparison S (𝟙 X) M' L').hom ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.targetCoordinates S (𝟙 X) (U.obj M') L').hom = (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.pullbackTensorComparison S (𝟙 X) M L).hom ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).map (T.map (Prod.mkHom (U.map f) (V.map g))) ≫ (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.targetCoordinates S (𝟙 X) (U.obj M') L').hom
